text_block_list.text: One day, I happened upon Vodka reading a book in the library—a rare sight indeed.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aaaargh!!
I don't get this at aaall!!
choice_data_list: What are you worrying about so much?
What are you worrying about so much?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. So, the thing is—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, do you realize what's at stake?
All kinds of people are coming to watch!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know that! Even if you don't tell me, I'm gonna show you my coolest side!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Sheesh, you worry too much.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"So that's how it is. After talkin' that big,
I can't go showin' any uncool side of myself."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna nail it right here and make that jerk's jaw drop!

I don't know the specifics, but judging by her enthusiasm,
she's probably racing Daiwa Scarlet or something.
If that's the case—
choice_data_list: Wouldn't training be the best option?
Wouldn't training be the best option?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I see!
I hadn't thought of that at all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer!
All right, let's hit the track right away!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah.........
I knew it, nothing beats this feeling of charging straight forward!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Thanks, Trainer.
This suits me way better than bowing and scraping!
Looks like this'll work out great—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Tonight's Christmas party!
choice_data_list: A Christmas party!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I got invited to this party event happening in front of the station, y'see.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So, I've been studyin' up on manners, etiquette, how to dress, and all that, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't need anything that stuffy!
It just needs to be sharp and snappy, like when I run!
choice_data_list: If it's a party, that changes everything!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've learned most of the manners already,
so enough is enough...
choice_data_list: You want to show off how cool you are, right?
You want to show off how cool you are, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry.
Just trust me."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I got all dressed up,
and they even taught me proper manners.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, above everything else, it reminded me
of the moment I look the absolute coolest.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So I'm definitely gonna liven up this party!

"It was purely coincidental, but going for a run
while troubled seems to have turned things in a good direction."
choice_data_list: Go show 'em how cool you are!
Go show 'em how cool you are!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks a lot!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, "go show them"...? You know you're coming too, right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: What!? I'm not ready for this!!
Huh!? But I'm not prepared at all!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry! You're my Trainer, right?
We'll make it work!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmm, and here I thought you'd be stiff with nerves, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like there's no need to worry.
Seems like she's her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Aren't I way cooler than usual!?
Take a good look!
Though the two were their usual selves, their lively presence made the party all the more exciting.

"It was purely coincidental, but going for a run
while troubled seems to have turned things in a good direction."
choice_data_list: Go show 'em how cool you are!
Go show 'em how cool you are!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks a lot!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, "go show them"...? You know you're coming with me, right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: What!? I'm not ready for this!!
Huh!? But I'm not prepared at all!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! I totally forgot to tell you~!
A-Anyway, let's hurry up and get ready, okay!?

And so the party began, and despite
some flustering moments along the way,
we somehow managed to get through it.

"It was purely coincidental, but going for a run
while troubled seems to have turned things in a good direction."
choice_data_list: Go get even cooler!
Come back looking even cooler!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
More than this? But that means
I actually have that potential, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Sounds good!
I'll show you an even cooler side of me than before!!

Afterward, we went to the party, and as expected,
there was plenty of drama with Daiwa Scarlet,
but somehow we managed to pull it off, and—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So, how was I today?
Pretty cool, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Not really... Wasn't it just average?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean?! We prepared
pretty darn hard for this, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Wasn't that for the best?
Hehe, you were completely your usual self!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat!!?
What the heck is thaaaat!!

And so, even though the party had ended,
we headed home amidst the lively atmosphere.

"It was purely coincidental, but going for a run
while troubled seems to have turned things in a good direction."
choice_data_list: You can look way cooler than that.
Come back looking even cooler!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
More than this? But that means
I actually have that potential, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Sounds good!
I'll show you an even cooler side of me than before!!

Afterward, we went to the party, and as expected,
there was plenty of drama with Daiwa Scarlet,
but somehow we managed to pull it off, and—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We managed to set up the party perfectly, but...
man, I am so exhausted...

It seemed like doing unfamiliar things had completely
exhausted her stamina, but it appeared to have
been a valuable experience for her nonetheless.
